data_description.clean_command_watch_timeout: Report clean commands that never start after this many seconds. Enter 0 to disable the check.
data_description.v1_local_status_poll_interval: Enter a value from 1 to 60 seconds. This only refreshes vacuum state, status sensor, and cleaning binary sensor.
data_description.v1_map_position_poll_interval: Enter 0 to choose automatically from the configured server, or a value from 1 to 300 seconds. This controls how often the vacuum position used by the danger-zone sensors is re-read. Leave it at 0 unless you self-host the server: map data always comes from the server, and polling Roborock's cloud too fast can get the account rate limited.
data_description.v1_stuck_detection_enabled: Report when the vacuum should be moving but is not, which is how a robot pressed against the cabinet door shows up. Fires roborock_plus_vacuum_stuck and turns on the stuck binary sensor. Detection only reports; stopping the robot is left to an automation.
data_description.v1_stuck_radius: How far the vacuum may drift, in map units, and still count as standing still. Default 200 clears the unit-or-two jitter seen between samples of a parked robot. Raise it if the robot is reported stuck while it is slowly working along an edge.
data_description.v1_stuck_window: How many seconds the vacuum may stay within the movement tolerance before it is reported stuck. Default 120. Detection needs several samples inside this window, so it also depends on the danger-zone polling interval.

garage_select.title: Select garage robot
garage_select.description: Select a V1 robot from this integration entry explicitly. Each door has one controller.

data_description.duid: Bind to the stable device duid rather than a mutable entity name.

garage.title: Garage settings and sources
garage.description: Configure {robot}. Choose the door, task mode and open/closed evidence sources first. Enabling continues to the selected feedback and safety confirmation; control starts only after the complete binding is saved. Disable to save an incomplete draft. New bindings default to disabled and hold_open.

data_description.enabled: Enable only after the binding, hardware calibration and handover are complete. Disabled bindings are saved as drafts.
data_description.cover_entity_id: Select the cover that supports opening and closing. Support for setting position does not prove physical position feedback.
data_description.task_door_mode: hold_open keeps the door open throughout the task. after_exit opens the door and confirms passage before starting the robot, without an extra departure pause; it closes only after trusted position confirms the robot is outside the door danger zone. Return must pause and confirm the robot has stopped, wait for full-open passage evidence, then use app_resume to resume the same return. Pause, door or resume failures block automation for manual handling. Users must validate the hardware timing, clearance and pause/resume behavior.
data_description.open_source: Choose explicitly: a contact endpoint, position feedback, or timing. An unavailable selected source never falls back to another source.
data_description.close_source: Choose independently from the open endpoint. Not closed does not mean fully open.
data_description.close_permission_entity: Optional input_boolean or binary_sensor, read only. Only on allows closing; off, unknown and unavailable deny it. Leaving this empty adds no household restriction.

garage_feedback.title: Selected feedback
garage_feedback.description: Only fields for the selected sources are shown. Set contact polarity and position kind from hardware tests; neither is inferred. Changing sources preserves previous values. An unavailable selected source never falls back to another source.

data_description.open_contact: Select a binary sensor for the open endpoint. Device class does not determine whether this sensor is usable.
data_description.close_contact: Select a separate binary sensor for the closed endpoint. Both endpoints cannot use the same entity.
data_description.open_contact_state: Choose on or off based on an actual endpoint test; polarity is never inferred.
data_description.close_contact_state: Choose on or off based on an actual endpoint test; polarity is never inferred.
data_description.position_kind: Measured means verified physical feedback. Estimated includes target echoes and software estimates, and requires accepting estimation risk.
data_description.open_position: For position evidence: enter a tested threshold from 0 to 100, above the closed threshold. Verify enough clearance for the robot; 95 is only an old setup suggestion.
data_description.close_position: For position evidence: enter a tested threshold from 0 to 100, below the open threshold. Verify it against physical closure; 5 is only an old setup suggestion.

garage_timing.title: Timing and handover
garage_timing.description: Usually only measured opening or closing travel needs entering. Auxiliary values are suggested and can be adjusted; existing values are preserved. Starred fields are required. Verify and manually select the two confirmations. Inactive-source values are retained; offline feedback cannot authorize passage.

data_description.open_travel_seconds: Enter the measured full travel time in seconds (1–600). A timed or estimated source waits the full journey; there is no universal default.
data_description.close_travel_seconds: Enter the measured full travel time in seconds (1–600). Opening and closing may take different times.
data_description.travel_margin_seconds: Suggested: 10 seconds, adjustable from 0 to 120. Added once to measured travel to allow for slower movement.
data_description.contact_settle_seconds: Suggested: 1 second, adjustable from 0 to 60. The endpoint contact must stay active continuously to filter brief changes. This does not make unreliable feedback reliable.
data_description.position_settle_seconds: Suggested: 2 seconds, adjustable from 0 to 60. Position must remain within the endpoint range; target echoes are still estimated.
data_description.operation_timeout_seconds: Initially suggested at least 90 seconds, or more for an already known longer travel. Must exceed the longest endpoint wait. For 35 seconds of travel plus 10 seconds of margin, choose more than 45 seconds, such as 90. A timeout blocks movement; it never grants passage.
data_description.dock_settle_seconds: Suggested: 5 seconds, adjustable from 1 to 300. At least two fresh dock observations must span this window; repeated old samples do not count.
data_description.allow_estimated: Timing cannot detect a jam, motor slip, or obstruction. Accept explicitly to use timed or estimated position evidence; estimates never become confirmed endpoints.
data_description.handover_confirmed: I calibrated endpoints/timing, checked that no task needs resuming and that the robot is safely docked, disabled old active door-control automations, and routed automatic closing through request_garage_close. Other robots sharing the legacy guard must be handled first.

start_garage_cleaning_stage.name: Start protected cleaning stage
start_garage_cleaning_stage.description: Start one explicit stage through the garage interlock and return its task receipt. Wait for the same receipt to succeed before starting the next stage; interruption, reset or reload invalidates the old sequence.

stage.name: Cleaning stage
stage.description: Explicit cleaning command, original parameters and complete fan, water and mop settings. Whole-home stages also require an explicit repeat setting.

previous_receipt.name: Previous successful stage receipt
previous_receipt.description: Omit for the first stage. Pass the unchanged runtime_id, session_id and interruption_revision from the previous successful stage for all later stages.

request_garage_close.name: Request guarded garage closing
request_garage_close.description: Request closing after rechecking the task, stable dock, trusted position, household permission and manual hold. There is no force bypass.

request_garage_open.name: Request guarded garage opening
request_garage_open.description: Request opening for an explicit household passage and wait for the full travel before reporting the door as passable. There is no force bypass. The close permission is not consulted because it only restricts closing.

reset_garage_control.name: Recheck garage control
reset_garage_control.description: Reobserve and clear recoverable faults or manual hold without moving the door or robot or erasing an active task. The next explicit request still passes all guards.
